info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Deposit Lending Virtual Account-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of virtual accounts for deposit lending services. It enables financial institutions and lenders to efficiently manage accounts for borrowers, enhancing support for loan processing and disbursement. Users can automate the setup of virtual accounts, allowing for quicker loan approvals and improved customer experiences. Typical consumers include banks, credit unions, and fintech companies seeking to streamline their lending operations.

post.summary: Create a virtual account for deposit lending.
post.description: This operation allows users to create a virtual account specifically for managing deposit lending transactions efficiently. It streamlines the process of tracking and handling deposit-related activities within the lending service.
